headline: Executive order adds new US sanctions on North Korea.
what_it_does: This order, signed by President Obama, adds sanctions against North Korea on top of those already in place. Sanctions usually limit trade, money transfers, or property dealings with targeted governments, groups, or people. Only the title was available, so the exact targets and penalties are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: The North Korean government and people or groups tied to it
who_it_affects.how: They may face new limits on dealings with the United States, based on the order's title.
They may need to follow new rules about dealing with anyone the sanctions target.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed January 2, 2015; the available material does not give a separate start date.
